name: Pipeliners - SEO Baseline 2026-07-22
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-07-22

# Summary
A 5-page Search Atlas baseline (OTTO project ca42c443, site audit 41385, rank tracker 34164) dated July 22, 2026. It argued that the gap between OTTO work and visibility was technical: broken sitemap, redirects, 4xx pages and failing Core Web Vitals.

# Key numbers
- OTTO score 78/100; issues found/deployed/pending 4,733 / 2,268 / 2,465 (52% deployed).
- 229 pages crawled (140 in OTTO); status 2xx/3xx/4xx = 141 / 64 / 24; indexable 130 vs 97 not.
- Rank tracker: 1 of 20 tracked commercial keywords in the top 100 ("sewer pipe lining cost" at 62).
- Largest pending OTTO buckets: links 535, knowledge-based trust 420, semantic analysis 371, schema 257, Twitter Card 242.
- Open technical fixes in order: Search Atlas GSC reads blocked (403), sitemap wrong, then redirects, internal links to redirects, 4xx pages.

# Notes
The next day's fuller baseline reframed this: the tracked keywords were national head terms the site was never positioned for, and GSC data should be reported instead of modelled numbers. See [Pipeliners - Full SEO Baseline Audit 2026-07-23](lib:brain-pipeliners-full-seo-baseline-audit-2026-07-23).
